question: People involved in _________ sector, process the primary materials and convert them into finished goods.
solution:
The correct answer is __**secondary.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The secondary sector is also known as the manufacturing sector, and it involves the processing of raw materials into finished goods. Examples of industries in this sector include automobile manufacturing, textile production, and electronics assembly.**
 
• The process of making bricks by using soil comes under the secondary sector of economic activity.
 
• There are three sectors of the Indian economy, which are primary, secondary, and tertiary.
 
• The **primary sector involves those activities which are dependent on the environment** for their production and manufacture.
 
• The **secondary sector** involves those activities in which the **raw materials are converted to finished goods.**
 
• **Tertiary sector** involves the activities which help in the development of both **primary and secondary sectors**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **irrigation** refers to the primary sector, which involves the extraction and harvesting of natural resources. Irrigation is a method of providing water to crops, which is a primary sector activity.
 
• **education **is a service sector that provides knowledge and skills to individuals. It is not directly related to the processing of raw materials into finished goods.
 
• ** primary, **refers to the primary sector, which involves the extraction and harvesting of natural resources. This sector includes activities such as farming, fishing, and mining.
